title: Opening: name and birth date in New Orleans
summary: Elgar gives his birth date, June 13, 1879, and full name.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: It ought to be on now. We may have to move that up a little bit. A little bit for you. I'll take the speaker off. Okay, that seems to be on now. Now, you might tell who you are, Mr. Elgore, and your birth date. It's the thing we'd like to know. You don't mind telling how old you are?
No, I don't mind that at all.
I was born on June the 13th, 1879, in the city of New Orleans.
Now, what is your full name?
My full name is Charles Anthony Elgore.
